attempts.text:
**The window starts at `cydC`.** Columns 0 to 2, `cydC`, `aat` and `infA`, are spine: 91 to 100% of chromosomes carry them, all persistent, and 0% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 91 to 100% of these genes, fewest at `aat`, 91%, and no column here hesitates more than 0.11 bits.

**Then 77 fork and variable columns**, 3 to 79, where 6 to 37% of calls are in a region of plasticity. Columns 3 to 39 are variable, 78 to 89% carried, 36 persistent families and 1 shell: `clpA` to `ybjL`, through the `art` and `pot` transporters, [[arginine and polyamine transport]]. The model names 33 to 99% of genes here, fewest at column 26, 33%, and hesitates most at column 49, 1.07 bits.

**Forks run from column 40 to 79.** A branch of 9 families through columns 40 to 48, all shell, 15 to 26% carried, follows a parallel path some chromosomes take instead: [[phage tail assembly]] proteins. A branch of 17 families through columns 54 to 70, 15 to 21%, carries `lysC`, `lysB`, `lysozyme` and capsid and terminase proteins, [[phage lysis and capsid assembly]]. Two smaller branches, 3 families each, sit at columns 74 to 76 and 77 to 79, 15 to 22%.

**The model names genes readily in the persistent stretches.** Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.58 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 96%; 7,882 of 42,960 calls are inside one. The window ends at column 79, `ybiO`, in 30% of chromosomes.

label: cydC
facts:
WINDOW: the cydC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cydC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,816 to 2,895 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cydC once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.43 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,550 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; shell 8,378 calls, named 79%, 1.07 bits; cloud 1,032 calls, named 7%, 4.27 bits. Outside an RGP 35,078 calls, named 96%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 7,882 calls, named 71%, 1.58 bits. Columns: 3 spine, 35 fork, 42 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.58 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 96%); 7,882 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 49 (yliI) 1.07 bits, RGP 30%; column 3 (clpA) 0.95 bits, RGP 9%; column 71 (opgE) 0.87 bits, RGP 27%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 3-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-37%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: cydC, aat, infA. named 91-100% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 1 (aat), named 91%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 1 (aat)).
2. columns 3-79 (77 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 6-37%. named 33-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 26, named 33%; most hesitant at column 49, 1.07 bits.
